messages:
mia: Hi all, first day! Running into onboarding blockers: my GCP project (proj-mia-01) can't create resources in asia-southeast1 (403) and I can't link a billing account. Also need AWS assume-role for terraform but don't see rdw-terraform in SSO. Who do I ping?

ravi: welcome @mia! paste the exact errors if you can.

mia: GCP errors: 
```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: Policy 'constraints/compute.restrictRegions' prevents this operation.
```
and when I try billing -> Link billing it says permission denied.

ops: thanks @mia. usually means project landed in a restricted folder. Can you share project number?

mia: project number 345678901234.

infra-bot: Org policy summary for project 345678901234: denies compute in asia-southeast1, disallows service account key creation. No billing account linked.

ops: Filed INFRA-9780 to move project to onboarding-sandbox, attach billingAccounts/5555-6666-7777, and grant `roles/billing.projectManager` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin` for onboarding. ETA 40m. If you need asia-southeast1 specifically, we need a region-exception justification for security review.

mia: I only need asia for demo latency tests, no customer data. Happy to file justification in the ticket.

security: @ops please note: region exceptions require sign-off if any PII or customer datasets will be used. Mia confirmed test data only.

mia: AWS side: terraform backend fails with assume-role denied. SSO shows no rdw-terraform target.

sso-bot: Submit an SSO request with target role arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/rdw-terraform and include your Okta email. If Okta group `infra-dev` is missing, request it in the same ticket.

ops: Adding Okta action to INFRA-9780: ensure `infra-dev` membership for mia and attach SSO request REQ-70421 when submitted.

mia: Submitted REQ-70421 and added justification to INFRA-9780 for asia-southeast1 demo usage. Thanks all!

ravi: nice, once INFRA-9780 and REQ-70421 are closed we'll mark onboarding cloud setup complete. :tada:
